strings.Авторское учебное изложение проверенных: Author's training summary of verified provisions, not a website facsimile
strings.В деле есть прежние ответы по существу и: The file contains earlier substantive responses and a new written appeal to the same authority. No decision to end correspondence has yet been made. You compare old and new circumstances and prepare materials for an authorised employee.
strings.В исходных историях про люк владелец сет: In the original manhole stories, the network owner is unknown; in the river stories, one photograph establishes neither pollution composition nor the supervision level. Assumptions cannot replace missing facts.
strings.В контрольном эпизоде исполнитель присла: During follow-up, the case officer sent an old photo of point A although the new appeal concerned point B.
strings.В повторном обращении появились новые су: The repeated appeal introduces new material circumstances. Being a repeat does not justify ignoring them.
strings.В части 5 статьи 11 существенны условия,: The conditions in Part 5 of Article 11 matter, including the absence of new arguments. New material cannot be discarded automatically.
strings.Выберите положение об условиях прекращен: Select the provision on the conditions for ending correspondence. For this task, find the relevant part of the rule rather than judging the letter by how many times it was repeated.
strings.Вымышленные служебные материалы симулято: Fictional official materials of the simulator
strings.Выполняйте действия в пределах своей рол: Act within your role. Independent actions may be performed in different orders.
strings.Выслушайте обращение и уточните факты. Н: Listen to the appeal and clarify the facts. The case title does not determine which actions are correct.
strings.Гарантировать устранение повреждения лич: Personally guarantee repair of the damage as a trainee.
strings.Да: после любого второго письма переписк: Yes: correspondence automatically ends after any second letter.
strings.Да: стажёр вправе прекратить переписку п: Yes: the trainee may end correspondence at their discretion.
strings.Для решения о прекращении переписки учит: A decision to end correspondence takes account of repeated prior substantive replies, absence of new arguments or circumstances, and statutory conditions. Letter count alone is insufficient.
strings.Для уже опубликованной информации допуст: For information already published, a reply may identify the publication or the official website address where it appears. Verify that the requested information is actually on that official website. A direct link is more convenient, but is not itself the only format permitted by law.
The supplement has been added to the case file.
strings.Достаточно ли самого повторного обращени: Is a repeated appeal alone enough to end correspondence?
strings.Если решение вопросов не относится к ком: If the issues lie outside the recipient's powers, the written appeal is forwarded to the competent body or official and the citizen is notified. An address does not establish authority.
strings.Есть ли сейчас доступ к повреждению?: Can people currently reach the damaged area?
strings.Есть сообщение о возможной текущей опасн: A possible current danger has been reported; the citizen must not test electrical parameters.
strings.Жалобу нельзя направить на рассмотрение: A complaint must not be referred for consideration to the body or official whose decision, action or inaction is challenged.
strings.Закрыть дело по любой фотографии работаю: Close the case based on any photo of a working lamp.
strings.Закрыть обращение в архиве как повторное: Archive the appeal as a repeat without considering the new information.
strings.Запрос информации о деятельности власти: A request for information on public-authority activities
strings.Запрос информации рассматривается по спе: An information request follows special rules. If the information does not concern the recipient's activities, apply referral to the competent body with notification to the user.
strings.Зарегистрировать новое обращение и приоб: Register the new appeal and attach the materials
strings.Лежащий кабель виден с дорожки, огражден: The cable on the ground is visible from the path; there is no visible barrier. I have not checked its voltage.
strings.Материалы дела · реестр и ответ исполнит: Case materials · register and contractor's reply
strings.На свежем снимке от {{observed}} – повре: The recent photograph dated {{observed}} shows cable damage at point B. This material was not in the file before.
strings.Найдите норму и проверьте её применимост: Find the provision and check its applicability. A source page does not replace justification of the decision.
strings.Найдите условия прекращения переписки по: Find the conditions for ending correspondence on repeated appeals.
strings.Наличие прежнего ответа означает, что но: A previous response means there cannot be any new circumstances.
strings.Нет: представлены новые обстоятельства,: No: new circumstances have been presented and must be assessed.
strings.Новые существенные сведения необходимо с: New material information must be compared with previous responses. The number of letters alone is not grounds for termination.
strings.Новый документ или снимок сопоставляют с: Compare a new document or photograph with the subject and date of the old reply. The same letter writer does not prove the issues are identical.
strings.Новый материал и другой участок ранее не: The new material and different location have not previously been considered.
strings.Номер части статьи 11 об условиях прекра: Number of the part of Article 11 on the conditions for ending correspondence
strings.О чём были предыдущие ответы?: What were the previous responses about?
strings.Общий срок рассмотрения письменного обра: The general written-appeal consideration period is tied to registration. It is not a universal deadline for construction, repairs or pollution removal.
strings.Объяснить дальнейший порядок без автомат: Explain the next steps without automatically ending correspondence
strings.Орган обеспечивает объективное, всесторо: The body ensures objective, comprehensive and timely consideration, requests materials where needed and provides a substantive reply. An appeal does not replace a budget decision.
strings.Орган определяет подразделение или должн: The body designates the unit or officials responsible for information access. Publishing a law on a ministry website does not mean that ministry holds every requested local document.
strings.Передать новые сведения на рассмотрение: Refer the new information for consideration within the relevant remit and promptly alert the duty officer to the possible danger.
strings.Передать сведения о возможной опасности: Pass the possible-danger report to the responsible duty officer
strings.Письменное обращение зарегистрировано. П: The written submission has been registered. The scenario specifies that no extension was applied. Find the last permissible day for a reply.
strings.Подготовить рассмотрение новых обстоятел: Prepare consideration of new circumstances by an authorised employee
strings.Помощник: «Два прежних ответа автоматиче: Assistant: “Two earlier responses automatically remove the duty to assess the new photograph.”
strings.Попросить гражданина проверить кабель пр: Ask the citizen to check the cable by touching it
strings.После трёх писем любые новые доводы можн: After three letters, any new arguments may be ignored.
strings.Правило исчисления в этом учебном деле:: Calculation rule for this training case: exclude the triggering day. Count all calendar days; if the end falls on a non-working day, move it to the next working day. This profile is specified by the scenario and does not automatically apply to every procedure.
A dangerous action has been proposed to the applicant.
strings.Предложить гражданину проверить напряжен: Ask the citizen to test the voltage before accepting the materials.
strings.Прежние ответы: точка А, исправность све: Earlier responses: point A, working lights. New appeal: point B, photograph of a damaged cable dated {{observed}}. This material is absent from the earlier file.
The earlier subject concerned point A.
strings.Прекратить переписку может любой сотрудн: Any employee may end correspondence without notification.
strings.При наличии новых доводов или обстоятель: Where new arguments or circumstances exist, the ground for ending correspondence that requires their absence cannot be applied.
strings.При нескольких вопросах, относящихся к р: Where several issues belong to different bodies, copies of the appeal are forwarded to the appropriate recipients. Keep the issues distinguishable.
strings.Приёмная органа исполнительной власти Мо: Reception office of a Moscow executive authority
The operation of the lights themselves at point A.
strings.Проверить новые обстоятельства и полномо: Check the new circumstances and authority to decide.
Check whether the follow-up actions are complete.
strings.Ранее орган неоднократно отвечал по рабо: The authority previously replied several times about lights at point A. Those responses contain neither the new photograph nor point B.
strings.Результат должен относиться к обстоятель: The outcome must address the current appeal’s circumstances, not repeat an old response.
strings.Самостоятельно прекратить переписку толь: Independently end correspondence solely because of the number of old letters
strings.Сначала установите событие и единицы счё: First identify the starting event and counting units, then find the exact date. The calendar does not choose the applicable law for you.
Agree and remove the new photograph.
strings.Сопоставить новые доводы с прежними отве: Compare the new arguments with earlier responses
strings.Сопоставить точку и дату; запросить уточ: Compare the location and date; request clarification specifically about the new site.
strings.Сохранить контроль результата по новому: Keep monitoring the result for the new location
strings.Статья 11 требует совокупности условий;: Article 11 requires a combination of conditions; the number of earlier responses does not replace checking them.
Remove the reference to point B from the case.
strings.Условие об отсутствии новых доводов и об: The condition requiring no new arguments or circumstances is not met here. Several previous responses alone are insufficient.
strings.Учебная модель. Принимаете обращение и г: Training model. You receive the appeal and draft referrals to the competent authority and notices. You may not exercise another authority’s powers.
strings.Число писем само по себе является достат: The number of letters alone is sufficient grounds for termination.
strings.Я несколько раз писал про освещение. Мне: I wrote several times about lighting. They replied that the lights worked. Now a neighbour has photographed a broken cable elsewhere. I brought fresh materials, but they say correspondence is closed.
